text.default: Warm hands, warm heart. Small rituals keep the farm bright in winter.
text.nature: The quiet season asks for gentle tending and soft routines.
text.market: Winter favors careful planning. Small rituals keep stocks steady.
text.slow: Settle in with warm rituals and the farm will feel like home.

pages.title: Snowdrop Bloom
pages.hint: Harvest snowdrops for the first time.

text.default: Snowdrops bloom even when the air bites. The farm learned resilience.
text.nature: Winter flowers remind the soil to keep breathing.
text.market: Even a small winter crop draws interest at market.
text.slow: Snowdrops are proof that gentle care still glows in winter.

text.default: Turnips keep the pantry kind. Simple crops, steady comfort.
text.nature: Spring roots settle in fast and quietly thrive.
text.market: Reliable spring roots keep sales smooth and calm.
text.slow: A turnip harvest is humble, and that’s the charm.

text.default: Ginger warms the hands and the ledger. Winter feels brighter.
text.nature: A warming root brings balance to the cold season.
text.market: Spice brings sparkle to winter baskets.
text.slow: Ginger’s warmth lingers. The farm feels cozy and alive.

pages.title: Hearth Market
pages.hint: Attend the Winter Hearth Market festival.

text.default: The hearth market glowed with warm light and shared stories.
text.nature: Even winter markets carry the rhythm of the land.
text.market: Warm gatherings make for thoughtful trades.
text.slow: You lingered by the hearth, letting the town’s warmth settle in.

pages.title: Seasonal Trimmings
pages.hint: Place a seasonal decoration on the farm.

text.default: Seasonal decor turns fields into cozy corners. The farm feels cared for.
text.nature: Decor echoes the season’s voice without a word.
text.market: A well-dressed farm always draws a friendly glance.
text.slow: Small touches make the whole farm feel like home.

pages.title: Pet Companions
pages.hint: Spend time caring for a pet.

text.default: A gentle companion keeps the days lighter and brighter.
text.nature: Companions share the quiet rhythm of the farm.
text.market: Happy pets keep the farm’s reputation warm.
text.slow: A few calm moments with a pet can reset the whole day.

pages.title: Cozy Goals
pages.hint: Complete a Cozy Goal from the Town Board.

text.default: Small goals keep the farm’s story moving without pressure.
text.nature: Gentle prompts keep you in step with the season.
